description.value: This spell functions like Shadow Summoning , except that it duplicates any summoner, necromancer, or geomancer summoning spell that summons a creature or item of 7th level or lower. The illusory summonings created deal three-fifths (60%) damage to nonbelievers, and non-damaging effects are 60% likely to work against nonbelievers.
